title: NEWM Community - Proof-of-Human (PoH) System - Enhance Security for Smart Contracts

ms.promise: This is the initial phase where we conduct a comprehensive review of the existing Proof-of-Human (PoH) solutions and the underlying technology. We'll further explore different methods of user verification (such as biometrics, CAPTCHAs, behavioral analysis) and study the feasibility of integrating them with the Cardano ecosystem. Additionally, we'll continue researching cryptographic proof generation and validation methods.
ms.criteria: We will be conducting fresh research on various forms of verification available which will be suitable for Cardano's ecosystem, Documentation of all our research findings and a feasibility report, possible challenges, and the proposed design will be done.

ms.promise: The PoH system is developed in this phase. It involves coding the user verification module, creating the cryptographic proof generation system, and implementing the proof validation system.
ms.criteria: Since it will be a completely new product and nothing of a similar nature exists we will be open-sourcing it and a Github link will be provided giving out all the documentation required to understand the technical nature of the product and its workings.
